answer: Sybil resistance uses one slashable bond per identity. Each agent locks stake to earn an attestation right; forging N personas needs N bonds, so an attacker cost grows linearly while a single honest vote carries the same weight as a fake one. A verifier checks the delta between declared and staked weight, slashing any mismatch. Picture a lagoon where every vessel must hold its own measure of saffron to enter: splitting into a fleet never cuts the total cargo.
